Friend list: the "persistent messages" status icon, the select-all box, the relationship icons.

ui.section: Official-client extras (all optional, off unless set)

ui.comment: The last avatar effect chosen in the effects list goes back on in every room entered.
The room snaps back to the centre when a drag ends.
An uncaught client error opens a window with a copyable report; show_stacktrace adds the stack.
"How does it work?" link of the mystery box panel: a help page ("habbopages/...") or a web address.
Left out, it opens the page that ships with the client; an empty value hides the link.
Welcome bubbles for a new player: "social" (navigator) or "quest" (progression); empty = none.
"Place more" button on the infostand of furni the Builders Club sells, for players who may build with it.
